title: Simple, Complex & Compound — Master Handnote
lede: একাডেমির হ্যান্ডনোট অনুযায়ী — তিন ধরনের বাক্যের গঠন, Golden Transformation Matrix, এবং ১০টি নিয়ম প্রতিটির তিন রূপ ও বাংলা অর্থসহ।

objectives.d: Finite verb কয়টি, আর clause কয়টি

objectives.t: Read the Golden Matrix across a row

objectives.d: Because of, In spite of, By, Without, Too…to

rules.name: তিন ধরনের বাক্যের গঠন
rules.bn: **Simple:** একটি মাত্র Subject ও একটি মাত্র **Finite Verb** (infinitive to+V1 বা participle V+ing থাকতে পারে, তবে মূল verb একটাই)। **Complex:** একটি Principal Clause + এক বা একাধিক Subordinate Clause। **Compound:** একাধিক Principal Clause, যুক্ত হয় **FANBOYS** দিয়ে।
rules.formula: Simple = 1 finite verb · Complex = Principal + Subordinate · Compound = Principal + FANBOYS + Principal
rules.ex: Complex-এর সংযোজক: ==Since, As, When, Though, If, So that, Who, Which, That== · Compound-এর: ==For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So==

rules.name: Reason or Cause (কারণ বোঝালে)
rules.bn: Simple বাক্যে **Because of / Owing to** থাকলে Complex-এ **Since / As / Because** এবং Compound-এ **and therefore / and so** বসে।
rules.formula: Because of / Owing to → Since / As / Because → And therefore
rules.ex: **S:** ==Because of== his illness, he could not attend the class. · **C:** ==Since== he was ill, he could not attend the class. · **Cd:** He was ill, ==and therefore== he could not attend the class.

rules.name: Contrast or Opposition (বিপরীত অর্থ বোঝালে)
rules.bn: Simple বাক্যে **In spite of** বা **Despite** থাকলে Complex-এ **Though / Although** এবং Compound-এ **but / yet** বসে।
rules.formula: In spite of / Despite → Though / Although → But / Yet
rules.ex: **S:** ==In spite of== working hard, the boy failed in the exam. · **C:** ==Though== the boy worked hard, he failed in the exam. · **Cd:** The boy worked hard, ==but== he failed in the exam.

rules.name: Positive Condition (হ্যাঁ-বোধক শর্ত)
rules.bn: Simple বাক্যে **By + V-ing** থাকলে Complex-এ **If + Affirmative** এবং Compound-এ **and** বসে।
rules.ex: **S:** ==By reading== attentively, you will get a GPA 5. · **C:** ==If you read== attentively, you will get a GPA 5. · **Cd:** Read attentively, ==and== you will get a GPA 5.

rules.name: Negative Condition (না-বোধক শর্ত)
rules.bn: Simple বাক্যে **Without + V-ing** থাকলে Complex-এ **If + do not** (বা **Unless**) এবং Compound-এ **or / otherwise** বসে।
rules.formula: Without + V-ing → If + not / Unless → Or / Otherwise
rules.ex: **S:** ==Without working== hard, you cannot prosper in life. · **C:** ==If you do not work== hard, you cannot prosper in life. · **Cd:** Work hard, ==or== you cannot prosper in life.

rules.name: Purpose (উদ্দেশ্য বোঝালে)
rules.bn: Simple বাক্যে **To / In order to** থাকলে Complex-এ **So that** (যাতে) এবং Compound-এ **wants to … and so** বসে।
rules.formula: To / In order to + V1 → So that / In order that → And so
rules.ex: **S:** He reads hard ==to get== good marks. · **C:** He reads hard ==so that he can get== good marks. · **Cd:** He ==wants to== get good marks, ==and so== he reads hard.

rules.name: Extreme Adjectives (অতিরিক্ত কিছু বোঝাতে)
rules.bn: Simple বাক্যে **Too … to** থাকলে Complex-এ **So … that** (এতই যে … না) এবং Compound-এ **Very … and** বসে।
rules.formula: Too … to → So … that (cannot / could not) → Very … and
rules.ex: **S:** He is ==too weak to walk==. · **C:** He is ==so weak that he cannot walk==. · **Cd:** He is ==very weak, and== he cannot walk.

rules.name: Simultaneous Action (একই সময়ে ঘটা দুটি কাজ)
rules.bn: Simple বাক্য **Verb + ing** দিয়ে শুরু হলে, Complex-এ **When / As / Since** এবং Compound-এ **and** বসে।
rules.formula: V-ing দিয়ে শুরু → When / As → And
rules.ex: **S:** ==Closing== the door, I went out. · **C:** ==When I closed== the door, I went out. · **Cd:** I closed the door ==and== went out.

rules.name: Adjective describing a Noun (Noun-এর দোষ/গুণ)
rules.bn: Simple বাক্যে Noun-এর পূর্বে **Adjective** থাকলে, Complex-এ **Relative Pronoun (who / which / that)** এবং Compound-এ **and** বসে।
rules.formula: Adjective + Noun → who / which / that → And
rules.ex: **S:** I saw a ==blind man==. · **C:** I saw a man ==who was blind==. · **Cd:** I saw a man, ==and he was blind==.

rules.name: Time — Age / Season / Year
rules.bn: Simple বাক্যে **At the age of / In / At** থাকলে, Complex-এ **When** এবং Compound-এ **and** বসে।
rules.formula: At the age of / In / At → When → And
rules.ex: **S:** ==At the age of four==, he left the village. · **C:** ==When he was four==, he left the village. · **Cd:** He was four ==and== he left the village.

rules.name: Object with Present Participle (Object-এর চলমান কাজ)
rules.bn: Simple বাক্যে **Object + V-ing** থাকলে, Complex-এ Object-এর পরে **Relative pronoun + Be verb** বসে।
rules.formula: Object + V-ing → who / which / that + be + V-ing → And
rules.ex: **S:** I saw a bird ==flying== in the sky. · **C:** I saw a bird ==which was flying== in the sky. · **Cd:** I saw a bird, ==and it was flying== in the sky.

drills.title: Practice Set 1 — Simple → Complex
drills.intro: প্রথমে marker শব্দটি খোঁজো — সেটিই বলে দেবে কোন সংযোজক বসবে।

items.q: Because of his illness, he could not attend the class.
items.ans: Since he was ill, he could not attend the class.

items.q: In spite of working hard, the boy failed in the exam.
items.ans: Though the boy worked hard, he failed in the exam.

items.q: By reading attentively, you will get a GPA 5.
items.ans: If you read attentively, you will get a GPA 5.

items.q: Without working hard, you cannot prosper in life.
items.ans: If you do not work hard, you cannot prosper in life.
items.why: Without + V-ing → If + do not / Unless। (নিয়ম ০৫)

items.q: He reads hard to get good marks.
items.ans: He reads hard so that he can get good marks.

items.q: He is too weak to walk.
items.ans: He is so weak that he cannot walk.

items.q: Closing the door, I went out.
items.ans: When I closed the door, I went out.

items.q: I saw a blind man.
items.ans: I saw a man who was blind.

items.q: At the age of four, he left the village.
items.ans: When he was four, he left the village.

items.q: I saw a bird flying in the sky.
items.ans: I saw a bird which was flying in the sky.

drills.title: Practice Set 2 — Simple → Compound
drills.intro: Compound মানে দুটি স্বাধীন বাক্য — FANBOYS দিয়ে জোড়া।

items.q: Because of his illness, he could not attend the class.
items.ans: He was ill, and therefore he could not attend the class.

items.q: In spite of working hard, the boy failed in the exam.
items.ans: The boy worked hard, but he failed in the exam.

items.q: By reading attentively, you will get a GPA 5.
items.ans: Read attentively, and you will get a GPA 5.

items.q: Without working hard, you cannot prosper in life.
items.ans: Work hard, or you cannot prosper in life.

items.q: He reads hard to get good marks.
items.ans: He wants to get good marks, and so he reads hard.

items.q: He is too weak to walk.
items.ans: He is very weak, and he cannot walk.

items.q: Closing the door, I went out.
items.ans: I closed the door and went out.

items.q: I saw a blind man.
items.ans: I saw a man, and he was blind.

items.q: At the age of four, he left the village.
items.ans: He was four and he left the village.

items.q: I saw a bird flying in the sky.
items.ans: I saw a bird, and it was flying in the sky.
items.why: Object-এর চলমান কাজ → and it was + V-ing। (নিয়ম ১১)

boardQ.instruction: Change the following sentences as directed. — নির্দেশ অনুযায়ী বাক্যগুলো পরিবর্তন করো। (5)

items.q: Because of his illness, he could not attend the class. (Complex)
items.ans: Since he was ill, he could not attend the class.

items.q: The boy worked hard, but he failed in the exam. (Simple)
items.ans: In spite of working hard, the boy failed in the exam.

items.q: If you read attentively, you will get a GPA 5. (Simple)
items.ans: By reading attentively, you will get a GPA 5.

items.q: Without working hard, you cannot prosper in life. (Compound)
items.ans: Work hard, or you cannot prosper in life.

items.q: He reads hard to get good marks. (Complex)
items.ans: He reads hard so that he can get good marks.

items.q: He is too weak to walk. (Complex)
items.ans: He is so weak that he cannot walk.

items.q: Closing the door, I went out. (Compound)
items.ans: I closed the door and went out.

items.q: I saw a man who was blind. (Simple)
items.ans: I saw a blind man.

items.q: When he was four, he left the village. (Simple)
items.ans: At the age of four, he left the village.

items.q: I saw a bird which was flying in the sky. (Simple)
items.ans: I saw a bird flying in the sky.

extras.title: The Golden Transformation Matrix — একই অর্থের তিন রূপ

rows: In / At the age of / At

extras.note: সারিটি চিনতে পারলেই তিনটি রূপ একসাথে বেরিয়ে আসে — ==কোন দিকে যেতে হবে== সেটাই শুধু প্রশ্ন বলে দেবে।

extras.title: সংযোজক শব্দ — কোনটি কোন বাক্যের

rows: Since, As, When, Though, Although, If, Unless, So that, In order that, Who, Which, That
For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So

tips.d: একটি সমাপিকা ক্রিয়া = ==Simple==। to+V1 বা V-ing থাকলেও সেগুলো finite verb নয়।
==Because of, In spite of, By, Without, To, Too…to== — এর যেকোনো একটি দেখলেই Matrix-এর সারি চিনে ফেলবে।
‘too weak to walk’ = হাঁটতে ==পারে না==। তাই Complex-এ ==cannot/could not== আর Compound-এ ==and he cannot== লিখতেই হবে।
==Unless== নিজেই না-বোধক — ‘Unless you do not work’ ভুল; ‘Unless you work hard’ সঠিক।
FANBOYS দিয়ে দুটি পূর্ণ বাক্য জুড়লে conjunction-এর ==আগে কমা== বসে।
বোর্ডে Simple→Complex যেমন আসে, Complex→Simple-ও আসে। Matrix-এর সারি ধরে ==দুই দিকেই== অনুশীলন করো।

recap: Simple = ১টি finite verb; Complex = Principal + Subordinate; Compound = একাধিক Principal + FANBOYS।
কারণ: Because of → Since/As → and therefore।
বিপরীত: In spite of → Though → but/yet।
শর্ত: By+V-ing → If → and; Without+V-ing → If not/Unless → or/otherwise।
উদ্দেশ্য: To → So that → and so; অতিরিক্ত: Too…to → So…that → Very…and।
গুণ: Adjective → who/which/that → and; Object+V-ing → which was + V-ing → and it was।
homework: Golden Matrix-এর ১০টি সারি না দেখে লিখে আনবে।
Practice Set 1-এর ১০টি বাক্য Compound-এও রূপান্তর করবে।
নিজে ৫টি Simple বাক্য লিখে তিন রূপেই রূপান্তর করবে।
